name: Order Fulfillment
description:
Pick, pack and hand off a wave of orders.

Could smoothing order releases outperform moving a worker?

Starting assumptions
• Exactly 120 orders are released in two bursts during a two-hour shift.
• Picking and packing have separate teams; inventory is always available.
• Picking time is an aggregate service duration, not a walking route or multi-item assembly model.

Synthetic teaching models. Timings, demand and staffing are illustrative; layout does not add travel time.
